Description: Found a Stripe Access Token, posing a risk to payment processing services and sensitive financial data.
Author: Jarich Ypma
Message:
docs(workflows): add periodic security/quality checks process + escalation

Adds a monthly cadence for the checks that only had a mise-task but no
enforced schedule (major-dependency review, SonarCloud backlog triage,
license report, CVE-exception re-review), tracked via one persistent
GitHub issue, so none of them silently depend on someone remembering.

Also adds direct GitHub-issue escalation on Critical/High findings from
the four already-automated scans (dependency-check, frontend vulnerability
scan, SonarCloud, secret scan), deduped against already-open issues, so a
production-relevant finding surfaces immediately instead of waiting for
the monthly batch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
